newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers adds to natural gas portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers adds to natural gas portfolio.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co on Monday said it agreed to acquire producing properties and undeveloped acreage in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas for $39.5 million from a Burlington Resources Inc's subsidiary.
The company also said it entered into definitive agreements to sell about $15 million in non-strategic producing properties in deals set to close in the second quarter 1997.

The properties acquired from Burlington Resources Oil and Gas Co hold estimated proved reserves of about 36.5 billion cubic feet equivalent of natural gas, which comprises more than 97 percent of the reserves, Cross Timbers said.

The deal, effective April 1 and set to close in May, boosts Cross Timbers natural gas reserves by about 7 percent, a spokesman said. The Fort Worth, Texas-based company reported natural gas reserves of 540.5 billion cubic feet at year end, he said.

The acquired properties primarily include operated interests in northwestern Oklahoma, southeastern Kansas and the Oklahoma and Texas panhandles with average net daily production of 5.5 million cubic feet of gas equivalent, the company said.
Cross Timbers this year earmarked $50 million of its capital spending budget for acquisitions, the spokesman said.
